brief.text: Good morning, Jebin! Sun Nov 15. Big day at the store: 4 parties — birthday 11am-1pm, birthday 2-4pm, birthday 3-5pm, corporate event 5:40-8pm. Make it a great one!

workout.text: AM upper+abs: floor press 3x10, rows 3x10/arm, shoulder press 3x10, curls 3x10, triceps ext 3x10, dead bugs 3x8/side. PM lower+abs: goblet squats 3x12, deadlifts 3x10, glute bridges 3x15, calf raises 3x15, plank 3x40s, twists 3x12/side.

next.text: Next: birthday party 11am-1pm at the store. 4 parties today — pace yourself and enjoy it!
